premises.text: Warehouse inventory control is manual, slow, and inaccurate across hundreds of thousands of warehouses
premises.evidence_span: The biggest problem in every one of these warehouses is keeping track of inventory. Today, that is a highly manual and incredibly slow process

premises.text: iFM automates inventory counting with flying robots using computer vision and robotics as a data-analytics stack
premises.evidence_span: we automate inventory counting using flying robots. iFM stands for Intelligent Flying Machines. At the core, we are a data analytics company using computer vision and robotics to automate data capture

premises.text: Robots fly indoors autonomously at centimeter accuracy without GPS by using computer vision and specialized hardware
premises.evidence_span: existing drones can only fly autonomously outdoors because they rely on GPS. We are using our computer vision software as well as specialized computing hardware to achieve centimeter accurate indoor autonomous flight

premises.text: Offering targets high-bay selective-rack warehouses with robots, relay infrastructure, and real-time analytics
premises.evidence_span: Today, our solution is geared towards a specific type of warehouse. The fancy term is high bay or selective rack

premises.text: Sell hardware with upfront setup/installation fees and software by subscription with data-driven premiums
premises.evidence_span: we're selling the software on a subscription basis, where as our system collects more information, we can add data-driven premiums
